contact_tolerance_2_3cm.reason: contact tolerance is an evaluation-tool parameter: widening it absorbs a method's failure to keep its ground; threshold sensitivity is covered by the +-0.5 cm threshold band

neck_reading.primary: joint line (ergo.neck_angles, revision 3 per-skeleton zero): the evalkit rula_* fields
neck_reading.sensitivity: rotation reading: head point = neck + R_head_global (head_rest - neck_rest), same zero (A = B in the rest pose); RULA rescored with only neck_flexion_deg and neck_side_bent replaced (evalkit.neck_rotation, from the row's cached fit and contact masks, no new solve)
neck_reading.methods: ARDY, CHOIS, Kimodo, PRIMAL; other methods not_applicable (CLoSD and legacy DART exports carry no rotations; MotionLCM / OmniControl neck excluded in revision 3)
neck_reading.gates: per row: rest-vector rebuild consistent within 0.5 deg, native A equals the evalkit source reading within 0.05 deg, recomputed joint-line classes equal the stored ergo_rula_class (约定，未经推演 thresholds, as registered in the neck supplement)
neck_reading.arms: run on every arm with ergo (pass 1 and pass 2); the rula_neck_rotation_* fields are load fields, so the merged view takes them from the self-floor row like the other rula_* fields
neck_reading.reading: descriptive; neither reading has a truth on generated motion (neck supplement); a method whose RULA conclusion differs between the readings is reported with both
neck_reading.command: scripts/run_evalkit_batch.sh runs it by default (--no-neck-rotation to skip); alone: evalkit_batch.py neck-rotation --manifest M --rows DIR

later_comparators.rule: comparators added after the main batch use the same contract and the same unmodified evalkit; their definitions are registered before any of their results is seen

post_hoc_correction.what: the same post-hoc correction (bone-length projection plus ground snap) applied to every baseline's output and later to the user's own method; no new generation (design section 8, section 14 item 5)
post_hoc_correction.run_directories: the corrected outputs are written as separate run directories that satisfy the same motion output contract (config/motion_output_contract_20261108.json), with a reference to the uncorrected source run and the correction version
post_hoc_correction.evaluation: evaluated by the same, unmodified evalkit; the correction must never be built into evalkit preprocessing
post_hoc_correction.defects: bone length and ground defects are always measured on the uncorrected outputs (as in v1.2: the self floor only makes loads computable and never hides a defect)

metric_correction_magnitude.meaning: how far the correction moves the joints: bone length pulled back and ground shift; it quantifies 'only a slight correction is needed'
metric_correction_magnitude.applies_to: every baseline and the user's own method, with the same correction
metric_correction_magnitude.definition: placeholder: the bone-length projection, the ground snap and the magnitude statistics are registered here once the user's own method has a prototype, before any result of the correction is seen

post_hoc_correction.timing: may wait until the user's method has a prototype

later_comparators.own_method: the user's own method enters under the same contract and evalkit at its final comparison (analysis plan split_use)

conventions_not_derived: stratum definition (method x condition x task x text_condition)
offset reference set (paused clock, lowest seed per condition x task, distinct inputs)
